recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Future GenomicStudy subject/focus maintenance should happen in the CG Incubator source if that external artifact drifts, not by editing or re-enabling the disabled core folder.
issue_request: FHIR-39109 was Published/Persuasive for R5 Clinical Genomics. It requested restricting GenomicStudy.subject to realistic genomic-study subject types, updating trio examples to use analysis.focus references to RelatedPerson instead of relying on DocumentReference.subject Group alone, and making similar MolecularSequence.subject limitations.
initial_application: The R5 source application is commit 12431eb8236aebd47261a4341d52f74c4327735b, merged by HL7/fhir#2712. That commit removed Device, Location, Organization, Procedure, Practitioner, and Medication from GenomicStudy.subject and MolecularSequence.subject, made GenomicStudy.analysis.focus repeatable, and added Patient plus RelatedPerson focus references to the trio example.
additional_context: FHIR-39110 handled the closely related MolecularSequence.focus addition and is already represented on the combined reconciliation branch. Later current-build cleanup removed GenomicStudy and MolecularDefinition from active fhir.ini entries, and FHIR-54345 confirms that current core links to these Clinical Genomics resources should point to CG Incubator. The CG Incubator continuous-build GenomicStudy StructureDefinition currently has the same subject target profiles and 0..* analysis.focus semantics.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source change was made. The residual core GenomicStudy files still contain the requested R5 correction, but they are outside the active current build; the active artifact is external to this checkout and already correct.
